about: An invented, labelled sample for measuring the redact task's NER pass. Every person and company is made up; places are ordinary public place names. Three registers: news-style sentences like the model's CoNLL-2003 training text, informal messages, and terse records such as tickets and logs. Each entity is [label, text], and its text occurs exactly once in the sentence.
